card.name: Commas inside lists of symptoms
card.fires_on: Commas (or 'and') right after an item in a running list of clinical findings or symptoms, such as 'respiratory distress,' or 'cyanosis,'. Also fires on a few list-like spots in other text.

modes.label: Symptom lists
modes.description: The comma after a symptom or finding in a list of reported signs.

modes.example: A launch system includes the launch vehicle<<,>> the launch pad and other infrastructure.
